statements.markdown: A subset Z ⊂ X consists of the eigensystems that have an automorphic point whose parameter contains a block of length t 0 (ZN); these Q are the lifts.

lean.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.ZN
lean.note: Membership requires a point with the prescribed parameter block of length R.t.
lean.fidelity_note: `ZN` requires an automorphic point giving the eigensystem and a base-change parameter containing the block $(1,\mu_C\ \text{twisted by}\ \eta_T^{-1},R.t)$. The paper specifies a block of length $t_0=\lfloor x^{401}\rfloor$ without naming its rank-one character.
